
 Usage: openajar access [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 What agents may do: grants, approvals, freezes and the action log.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ grants        Issue, narrow, inspect and revoke grants.                      │
│ approvals     The Needs-you queue.                                           │
│ confirmation  How strong a yes must be, and where it can be given.           │
│ freeze        Freeze a lane, a workspace or this node: every agent stops at  │
│               once.                                                          │
│ unfreeze      Lift a freeze (owner only; nothing is restored).               │
│ audit         The tamper-evident action log: verify, replay, export, share.  │
│ policy        Grants, approvals, the action log and notifications.           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
